hook_line: ADANI ENTERPRISES PLANS RS 35,000-40,000 CRORE CAPEX A YEAR

hook_stat.sub: Record first-half EBITDA, up 56% year on year

stats.label: Rise in consolidated income, to Rs 71,569 crore
Passengers a year targeted at Navi Mumbai airport by end of FY28

diaspora_bullets: Airports, data centres and the Mundra PVC complex do the heavy lifting
Its eight airports handle about 23% of India's passenger traffic
news_summary: Adani Enterprises plans capital expenditure of Rs 35,000 crore to Rs 40,000 crore a year over the next couple of years, after record first-half EBITDA of Rs 11,958 crore.
payoff: The next signals: PVC commissioning, data-centre capacity toward 500 MW, and the Navi Mumbai airport ramp.
